title: A Long Way Back
summary:
Oil demand recovery not expected until 2022
Last week, the three main oil market analysis agencies (International Energy Agency (IEA), OPEC and the US Energy Information Administration (EIA)), published their short-term oil market forecasts for 2020 and 2021. This week we will take a look at their outlook for oil demand recovery, after Covid-19 devastated demand in Q2, and what this might mean for the tanker markets. The IEA estimates that global oil demand in the second quarter of 2020 declined to 83.2 Mb/d from 99.3 Mb/d in the prior year (-16.2%), as many countries announced restrictions to slow the spread of Covid-19.
